provenance.footprints: Conservative authoring reserves in metres, not measured bounds; actual scene geometry, terrain fit and approach orientation require one server and at most one client.
provenance.loot: Only pieces explicitly marked proto emit mapgrouppos rows. Static furniture/crates/cots/radios do not generate loot. Tier hints are placement guidance only.
provenance.method: tools.audit.pbo_config.read_configs/read_pbo_index; inherited model/scope resolved within addon; no PBO byte-name-only admission. tools.package.map_overlay.read_proto_names for mission group evidence.
provenance.source: Installed DayZ client addons, read-only CfgVehicles config.bin derap; installed Chernarus+ mission mapgroupproto.xml exact group-name join (2026-11-20).
provenance.verified: CfgVehicles definition, resolved scope/model, all 79 referenced models found as .p3d members in installed structure PBO indexes, and exact loot prototype presence. Scope 1 world props are retained (not inventory items). This does not establish CreateObjectEx success, collision, pivot, entrance orientation, light emission or CE spawning.
